title: Task Inputs, Outputs, Incrementality, and Determinism Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies task inputs, outputs, incrementality, and determinism?
options: Declare the complete output function and make generation deterministic, isolated and relocatable.
Declare the project absolute path as content
questions.answer: Declare the complete output function and make generation deterministic, isolated and relocatable.
questions.explanation: The correct approach preserves Gradle’s lazy model, explicit data flow, variant correctness, functional evidence and operability.

questions.prompt: UP-TO-DATE and FROM-CACHE describe the same reuse location.
questions.explanation: Using the current timestamp in generated JSON while omitting it from inputs makes identical cache keys produce different bytes and poisons shared reuse.

questions.prompt: What is the core cacheability invariant?
questions.answer: Equivalent declared inputs and implementation must produce equivalent relocatable outputs without undeclared side effects.
questions.explanation: The answer names the model property that makes the build behaviour predictable rather than relying on incidental script order.
